summary: First full-stack test pass on SwapKaro. Backend: 23/23 pytest cases pass after fixing 2 endpoints (send_message and bot reply were returning 500 due to MongoDB ObjectId leaking into response). All AI endpoints (matches/ai, verify-quiz, swaps agreement, bot) work, with graceful fallbacks when Claude returns budget-exceeded. Frontend: splash → onboarding → login (10-digit phone + 6-digit auto-advance OTP) → setup (3 steps) → home tab works end-to-end. 4-tab bottom nav (Barter/Matches/Swaps/Profile) navigates correctly. Home shows greeting, category chips, 99% match banner, feed cards with give/want pills. Matches shows AI scanning animation. Profile renders SwapScore, score bars, Pro upsell. UI bugs found: onboarding slide headlines not visible (DOM has text but rendered off-screen/invisible), seeded users not reachable via login due to phone-format mismatch (+91- prefix not added). Deprecated React Native style warnings detected (shadow*, pointerEvents).

minor.issue: Was returning 500 (MongoDB ObjectId in response). FIXED by adding msg.pop('_id', None) before return.
Was returning 500 (MongoDB ObjectId in response). FIXED by adding msg.pop('_id', None) before return.

ui_bugs.issue: Slide content (image + headline 'Apna Hunar Do' / 'AI Dhundega Match' / 'Barter Karo, Badho' + subtitle) is present in DOM (body.innerText returns all 3 slide strings) but NOT rendered visually in viewport — screen shows only black background with bottom 'Aage Badho' button and dots indicator. Likely a FlatList/ScrollView width/horizontal positioning issue or images failing to load (no Skip-style overflow visible). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(auth)/onboarding.tsx

The 6 OTP digit boxes show very low contrast text — digits typed are barely visible in dark boxes. Functionally works (auto-advance + auto-submit), but visually hard to verify. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(auth)/login.tsx

User enters 10-digit phone (e.g., 9000000001) but backend seeded users use '+91-9000000001'. Frontend submits raw 10-digit (or +91 prefix without dash) so seeded users (Rahul Mehta, Priya Sharma, etc.) are unreachable via demo login — instead a new blank user gets created and routed to /setup. Either (a) normalise to '+91-{10digits}' before submit OR (b) update seed data to '+91XXXXXXXXXX' (no dash) and match. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(auth)/login.tsx

integration_issues.issue: Could not verify in UI because session was reset between automation runs (browser localStorage cleared). Backend create_swap + chat endpoints all pass via pytest. UI navigation from card 'Swap Request Bhejo' button could not be reached after re-auth because seeded users not directly loggable (see above).

action_items: Fix onboarding slide rendering — slide content (image, title, subtitle) is in DOM but invisible. Likely the slide container width is 0 or images are 404. Check Animated FlatList/ScrollView item width and image URLs.
Normalise login phone to '+91-{phone}' (dash format) before submitting to backend so demo flow can log into seeded users (Rahul Mehta etc.).
OTP screen: horizontal row of 6 boxes overflows beyond 390px viewport — reduce box width or add gap shrink so all 6 boxes fit. Increase text contrast inside boxes.
Migrate React Native style props: replace 'shadow*' shorthand with 'boxShadow' (or use shadowOffset/shadowColor with explicit values) and move pointerEvents into style object.

Re-run end-to-end UI test of: chat (agreement bubble + send message + SwapBot toggle + milestone mark), Pro upgrade modal, Boost screen, Verify quiz, Notifications screen — these were not verified in UI but backend endpoints pass.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py: send_message and bot endpoints previously returned the dict that motor mutated with ObjectId. Fixed via .pop('_id', None). Consider adopting a helper or use return-by-fetch pattern consistently.
/app/backend/server.py: @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI ≥0.93; consider lifespan context for future-proofing (non-blocking).
Seed data phones use '+91-XXXX' format; frontend login likely sends raw 10-digit. Align both.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (added msg.pop('_id', None) in send_message and ask_bot)

success_rate.frontend: ~70% (auth/setup/home/tabs work; onboarding visual broken; chat & pro/boost/verify/notifications screens not fully UI-verified due to session reset)

Focus next iteration on: (1) verify onboarding slides render visually after main-agent fix, (2) verify chat agreement bot bubble + Mark milestone done flow, (3) verify Pro upgrade / Boost / Verify (quiz) / Notifications screens render and integrate. Use phone format '+91-9000000001' through API directly to access seeded users until frontend normalisation is fixed. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget hits occasionally — backend has fallbacks so all endpoints still 200.
rca_of_issue: send_message/bot 500: motor's insert_one mutates the inserted dict in-place adding ObjectId('_id'). Returning that dict triggers Pydantic serialization failure. Mitigation: explicitly remove '_id' before return (applied).
